32 new stars this week.
CDAF replaces repeated AI video analysis with a plain-text sidecar description format that agents read instead of watching footage. In benchmarks with Gemini 2.5 Flash, sidecars matched direct video accuracy at 10x lower token usage. It includes a Python CLI generator and an agent skill that verifies sidecars against video file hashes.
